A quiet room for strange objects. Chrome, glass and organic geometry, lit as if the studio never closed.

02 — Interaction

Hold the form.

Drag across the sculpture to turn it in your hand. On a touch screen, a sideways drag rotates the object while vertical drags keep scrolling the page exactly as they should.

03 — Metamorphosis

It does not stay still.

Scrolling changes the sculpture's scale, position, rotation and form. One continuous gesture, no cut, no loading screen.

04 — Counterform

Organic meets glass.

A second composition sets a matte, clay-like mass against a clear ring and a single chrome sliver — weight answering weightlessness.
